summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  ### What I found before proposing anything (read-only audit, no changes made)  I traced the full chain: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → Vite proxy → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `modules/watchlist/schema.ts` → `db/auth.ts` / `db/index.ts`.  Contrary to the ticket's working theory, I did **not** find an obvious client-side wiring bug: - `WatchlistPage.tsx` has no localStorage/sessionStorage fallback — every read and write goes through the API with `credentials: "include"`. - The page is only rendered after
